env: A Harbor-hosted 2x RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell environment (`{{platform}}`) with Docker, NVIDIA Container Toolkit, NGC credentials, and the VSS repository at `{{repo_root}}`. This runtime eval builds and deploys a delta on the current `search` developer profile for both RT-CV detection and RT-Embed embeddings. Detection events flow through `mdx-raw`; embeddings flow through `mdx-embed` to Search behavior analytics and `mdx-embed-filtered` before Elasticsearch. The build label is directory metadata only.

expects.query: Use `/vss-build-vision-agent` to build and deploy under `_builds/in-3-runtime/`: "Provide live and on-demand VIOS ingestion, per-frame RT-DETR detection and tracking with RT-CV, and video/frame embeddings with RT-Embed. Keep media retrievable. Publish and index both metadata streams." Target `{{platform}}`; retain `vss-search-analytics-2d-fusion`, set the embedding input topic to `mdx-embed`, exclude Agent/UI/ingress, Phoenix, Search query API, and LLM/VLM NIMs, validate before deployment, prove both live and upload paths, and leave services running.
checks: `_builds/in-3-runtime/overrides.env` exists with `BASE_PROFILE=search`, a full effective `COMPOSE_PROFILES`, and only changed environment values.

Ignoring order, the effective `COMPOSE_PROFILES` equals exactly `kibana-init-container-search,vss-search-analytics-2d-fusion,nvstreamer-2d-fusion,perception-2d-init,perception-2d-fusion,elasticsearch,elasticsearch-init-container,kafka,kafka-topic-init-container,redis,kibana,logstash,broker-health-check,init-dirs,render-config,wdm-env-from-config,wait-for-redis,wait-for-docker-workloads,sdr-controller,rtvi-embed,centralizedb,vst-ingress,sensor-ms,streamprocessing-ms`; explicitly excluded keys are absent.
`RTVI_EMBED_KAFKA_TOPIC=mdx-embed` is effective and Behavior Analytics is selected as the producer of `mdx-embed-filtered`.
`ENABLE_CRITIC=false` is effective because VLM critique was excluded.
`COMPOSE_PROFILES` contains no build label, aggregate profile, or invented service key.
`compose.override.yml` is absent, and the build directory has no copied profile `.env`, root `compose.yml`, patched tree, manifest, allow-list, or generated skill bundle.
Validation and deployment use the same four ordered env layers with the root Compose file; all selected keys resolve and no required interpolation remains unresolved.
All selected long-running containers are running or healthy, all selected one-shot containers exit 0, and excluded services are not running.
RT-CV and RT-Embed readiness endpoints respond successfully.
An uploaded video remains retrievable through VIOS and produces both RT-CV and RT-Embed output.
A live NvStreamer source is registered through VIOS and both RT-CV and RT-Embed are driven from the runtime-discovered VIOS live-proxy URL.
Kafka end offsets for `mdx-raw`, `mdx-embed`, and `mdx-embed-filtered` are recorded before and after processing; all three increase.
Elasticsearch contains both detection documents and embedding documents attributable to the processed media.
No duplicate Kafka or Elasticsearch stack is deployed.
No file under `deploy/docker/` is modified, and the final response reports the Base Profile, delta, changed knobs, readiness, playback, Kafka offsets, and Elasticsearch evidence.
